shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: A confident, well-dressed Nigerian woman in her forties, the treasurer of a residents' association, works on a laptop at a tidy desk in the estate's management office, smiling slightly as she reviews figures. Through the window: interlocking paving, a gatehouse barrier and palms. Bright daylight. Laptop screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: A handsome Nigerian estate manager in his late thirties, in a crisp shirt and trousers, walks along a clean estate street lined with duplexes and painted fences, glancing at his smartphone. Palms, water tanks and a parked generator housing in the background. Warm morning light. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: tip
shots.prompt: A good-looking Nigerian man in his early fifties, wearing a neat kaftan, sits on the porch of his duplex in a gated Lagos estate, reading a message on his phone with a warm, reassured smile. Potted plants and interlocking paving around him. Soft late-afternoon light, the lower third of the frame in shade. Phone screen facing away from camera.
